disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly provided false information during application for licensure or hospital privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly provided false information during any application for professional licensure or hospital privileges, whether by making any affirmative statement which was false at the time it was made or by failing to disclose any fact material to the application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual user of drugs or intoxicants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a habitual user of drugs or intoxicants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Medical practice incompatible with basic knowledge and competence expected of licensed physicians
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has displayed medical practice which is incompatible with the basic knowledge and competence expected of persons licensed to practice medicine or any particular aspect or specialty thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonest or unprofessional conduct or been grossly or repeatedly negligent in practicing medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in dishonest or unprofessional conduct or has been grossly or repeatedly negligent in practicing medicine or in performing activities ancillary to the practice of medicine or any particular aspect or specialty thereof, or has intentionally injured a patient while practicing medicine or performing such ancillary activities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or allowed an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or allowed an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to provide adequate safeguards in regard to aseptic techniques or radiation techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to provide adequate safeguards in regard to aseptic techniques or radiation techniques.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Included in advertising statements tending to deceive or mislead the public or claiming professional superiority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has included in advertising any statement of a character tending to deceive or mislead the public or any statement claiming professional superiority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised use of drug or medicine of unknown formula or unnamed/misnamed anesthetic system
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised the use of any drug or medicine of an unknown formula or any system of anesthetic that is unnamed, misnamed, misrepresented, or not in reality used.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated any provision of the medical practice chapter or substantive board rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully or repeatedly violated any provision of this chapter or any substantive rule of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony under the laws of the United States or any state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony under the laws of the United States or any state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain adequate medical record documentation or unreasonably delayed medical record transfer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to maintain adequate medical record documentation on diagnostic and therapeutic treatment provided or has unreasonably delayed medical record transfer, or violated RSA 332-I.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly obtained or assisted in obtaining prescription for controlled substance without valid physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly obtained, attempted to obtain or assisted a person in obtaining or attempting to obtain a prescription for a controlled substance without having formed a valid physician-patient relationship pursuant to RSA 329:1-c.

value: special license with conditions, limitations, or restrictions
license_status_types.quote: The office shall grant an unrestricted permanent license to persons it finds to have the necessary professional qualifications. The office may also, in consultation with the board, by consent or after notice and the opportunity to be heard, resolve issues concerning professional qualifications or circumstances that would be grounds for non-disciplinary remedial action against a licensed physician by granting a temporary license, or a temporary or permanent license with restrictions. ... The office shall issue special training licenses ... The office may issue special licenses containing conditions, limitations, or restrictions ... The office may issue courtesy licenses ... The office may issue licenses authorizing the practice of medicine limited to administrative medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must have studied medicine in a school recognized by the United Nations World Health Organization (UNWHO) and have had such studies confirmed by Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) Certification
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: has studied medicine in a medical school located outside the United States which is recognized by the United Nations World Health Organization (UNWHO) and had such studies confirmed by Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) Certification

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed at least 2 years of postgraduate training approved by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education, or its equivalent as determined by the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine, with subsequent evaluation at intervals appropriate for the patient and medical condition but not less than annually, in compliance with federal and state laws. Physicians must establish a physician-patient relationship including in-person exam or telemedicine exam with identity verification, disclosure of physician information, and informed consent.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine. When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine a subsequent evaluation shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually. All prescribing shall be in compliance with all federal and state laws and regulations.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: An out-of-state physician providing services by means of telemedicine shall be deemed to be in the practice of medicine and shall be required to be licensed under this chapter.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every insurer, including self-insurers, providing professional liability insurance to a licensee of the board shall send a complete report to the board as to all reservable claims coincident with medical injury that take place in this state or in any other state within 30 days after establishing the reserve.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every facility administrator, or designee, for any licensed hospital, health clinic, ambulatory surgical center, or other health care facility within the state shall report to the office any disciplinary or adverse action, within 30 days after such action is taken, including situations in which allegations of misconduct are settled by voluntary resignation without adverse action, against a licensed individual.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification may contract with other organizations to operate the professionals' health program for physicians and physician associates who are impaired or potentially impaired because of mental or physical illness including substance abuse or disruptive behavior.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The office may issue licenses authorizing the practice of medicine limited to administrative medicine for physicians whose practice does not include the provision of clinical services to patients.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: The state of New Hampshire confirms its strong support for shared decision making between health care professionals and their patients. A licensee may lawfully prescribe an FDA approved drug product for an off-label indication and be held to the same standard of care as when prescribing for on-label indication when: (a) Off-label use of the drug product for this indication has longstanding common use; (b) There is medical evidence to support this use and no known evidence contraindicating such use, including but not limited to, peer reviewed studies and practice guidelines from relevant medical societies; or (c) The licensee has provided and the patient, or if the patient is a minor, the patient's parent or guardian, has signed an informed consent form
